plugins.name: tiger-skills
plugins.description: Coding through one command: /vibe. It classifies the request and conducts the work in a fixed order: the tiger-planner agent draws the decision tree and plans, you answer what is open, tiger-engineer agents build, and the tiger-reviewer agent checks. The agents carry the best-practice skills: planning, decision tree, grill, code quality, design principles, refactoring, performance, logging, configuration, Terraform, full stack, hexagonal architecture, verification, code map, review.
